steps.caption: Open Deal toolkit from the sidebar.
How to read this page opens a short guide to every box and label on this screen.
Compare over 60 months at a 10% discount rate.
Stay: the landlord's renewal rent of ₹21.5 lakh a month, plus CAM and a refurbishment.
Move: new rent, 3 months rent-free — and 2 months of overlap paying both rents.
Moving costs: fit-out, moving, restoring the old office, IT, downtime and deposits.
Non-money factors (location, disruption…) are scored 1–5 separately — optional, never mixed into cost.
Compare & save — fixed formulas, not AI.
The answer: staying is cheaper in today's money. Non-money scores are kept separate.
Break-even: the month moving would become cheaper — here, not within 60 months.
Present-value difference: positive means moving costs more in today's money.
Cost over time: running totals — dashed is stay, solid is move. If they cross, that is break-even.
Line by line: every cost behind each total, including the overlap rent.
Quoted = from a landlord or partner document; Estimated = your own assumption. The label follows the number everywhere.
How we calculated this: the formula version and every step, so anyone can check the maths.
Each save is a version. Change any input and recalculate — earlier versions are kept, never overwritten.
Download deck makes an editable PowerPoint of these results for the client.
